page.overview:
Who is Julius?

is the main antagonist of The Breaking Wheel, the second story in Fazbear Frights 7: The Cliffs. He is a cruel and relentless bully who enjoys tormenting others and bragging about his intelligence. When Reed traps him in his own exoskeleton suit, he is filled with rage and promises to tear the outcast apart.

Julius has artful wavy blond hair that cascades down the back of his head. Shelly says his hair is “dreamy.” Julius is tall and muscular with big, long limbs and a V-shaped torso. Many find him to be attractive. His canine teeth are unusually pointed. Julius always wears expensive clothes, such as skinny black jeans, expensive basketball shoes, designer shirts, and cashmere scarves.

After his prolonged torture in his exosuit, Julius is described by Reed as a fleshy octopus-like mass of pulpy crushed limbs attached to a metal frame. His face is slack due to the bone structure of his forehead, cheeks, and jaw having been pulverized. His features are so distorted that he is said to resemble a crudely sewn cloth doll. His wavy blond hair is now sticky and stringy with congealed blood and fresh blood pools from his face, which is compared to a misshapen sponge. His mouth is sagging and his eyes have rolled back in his head, showing the murky, cloudy whites. His flesh and stylish clothing have been pierced by puncture wounds caused by cracked bones and are smeared with dried and fresh blood. His previously cream-colored scarf looped around his neck is also saturated.

Julius is an odd combination of jock, brain, and bully. He loves to brag about his talents and his self-righteous beliefs to everyone, and he demonstrates his intelligence through his skills at robotics, creating a fully functional exoskeleton suit. When things don’t go his way, Julius will complain and blame his problems on others. He also thrives on insults and bullying, seemingly getting euphoric when humiliating and physically hurting others.
